title: stachys ocymastrum subsp. bicolor
intro: Stachys ocymastrum subsp. bicolor, commonly known as Alpine Betony, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to the mountainous regions of Central and Southern Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Betony include its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Stachys ocymastrum subsp. bicolor include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
